title: Susan McCasland's Facebook statement on Roswell bodies and debris at Wright-Patterson
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Susan McCasland's Facebook statement on Roswell bodies and debris at Wright-Patterson, about 2026 at Wright-Patterson Air Force Base, Ohio, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Neil does not have any special knowledge about the ET bodies and debris from the Roswell crash stored at Wright Pad.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, reads from what he presents as a 2026 Facebook post by Susan McCasland, a senior US Air Force officer. In it, he says, she writes that a man named Neil "does not have any special knowledge about the ET bodies and debris from the Roswell crash stored at Wright-Pat", Roswell being the 1947 New Mexico event where a flying saucer is said to have come down, and Wright-Patterson an Air Force base in Ohio. Michels raises it because the wording seems to take for granted that alien bodies and wreckage are kept at that base.
